title: Claude: Degraded Performance for Multiple AI Models
summary: Anthropic's Claude status page reports degraded performance and elevated errors affecting multiple AI models, including Claude Mythos 5, Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. The issue impacts claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork. The team is investigating and will provide updates.
key_points: Degraded performance reported for multiple Claude AI models (Mythos 5, Fable 5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5).
Elevated errors observed in requests to affected models.
Incident impacts claude.ai, Claude API (api.anthropic.com), Claude Code, and Claude Cowork.
Anthropic's team is actively investigating the issue.
Updates will be provided as the situation progresses.
